errors.message: Missing API key. Send it in the Authorization header as 'Bearer <key>'.

zh-CN.title: 需要 API 密钥
zh-CN.explanation: 此接口需要 API 密钥，但请求中没有携带。
steps: 在 Authorization 请求头中以 Bearer <密钥> 的形式发送密钥。
Anthropic 客户端也可以用 x-api-key 请求头发送。
如果还没有密钥，请向服务管理员申请。

en-US.title: API key required
en-US.explanation: This endpoint needs an API key, and the request did not include one.
steps: Send the key in the Authorization header as Bearer <key>.
Anthropic clients can send it in the x-api-key header instead.
If you have no key yet, ask the service owner for one.

errors.message: Invalid API key. Check the key; it may be mistyped or may have been rotated.

zh-CN.title: API 密钥无效
zh-CN.explanation: 请求中的密钥与任何有效密钥都不匹配，可能输错了，也可能已被轮换。
steps: 从管理员分享的位置重新复制密钥，注意不要带多余空格。
如果密钥已轮换，请改用新密钥。
同一地址多次认证失败会被暂时封禁。

en-US.title: API key not recognized
en-US.explanation: The key in the request does not match any active key. It may be mistyped or may have been rotated.
steps: Copy the key again from where the owner shared it, without extra spaces.
If the key was rotated, use the new one.
Repeated failures from one address are blocked for a while.

errors.message: This API key has expired. Ask the service owner to renew it.

zh-CN.title: API 密钥已过期
zh-CN.explanation: 此密钥已超过有效期，无法继续使用。
steps: 请联系服务管理员续期或签发新密钥。

en-US.title: API key expired
en-US.explanation: This key has passed its expiry date and no longer works.
steps: Ask the service owner to renew the key or issue a new one.

errors.message: This API key is disabled or has been revoked.

zh-CN.title: API 密钥已停用
zh-CN.explanation: 服务管理员已停用或吊销此密钥。
steps: 请联系服务管理员确认能否恢复，或申请新密钥。

en-US.title: API key disabled
en-US.explanation: The service owner has disabled or revoked this key.
steps: Ask the service owner whether the key can be re-enabled, or request a new one.

errors.message: This API key is not allowed to use this endpoint.

zh-CN.title: 此密钥无权访问该接口
zh-CN.explanation: 密钥有效，但不包含访问此接口的权限。
steps: 在“我的密钥”页面查看密钥可用的接口。
如需使用，请让服务管理员为密钥添加相应权限。

en-US.title: Endpoint not allowed for this key
en-US.explanation: The key is valid but does not include permission for this endpoint.
steps: Check which endpoints your key may use on the My Key page.
Ask the service owner to add the permission if you need it.

errors.message: This API key is not allowed to use the requested model.

zh-CN.title: 此密钥无权使用该模型
zh-CN.explanation: 密钥有效，但不允许使用请求的模型。
steps: 通过 /v1/models 查看密钥可用的模型。
如需使用，请让服务管理员把该模型加入密钥的允许列表。

en-US.title: Model not allowed for this key
en-US.explanation: The key is valid but may not use the requested model.
steps: List the models your key may use at /v1/models.
Ask the service owner to add the model to your key.

errors.message: Requests from this web origin are not allowed for this API key. Add the origin under My Key.

zh-CN.title: 网页来源不被允许
zh-CN.explanation: 此密钥不接受来自发起请求的网页来源。
steps: 在“我的密钥”中添加该网页的来源。
服务端程序不发送来源，不受此限制。

en-US.title: Web origin not allowed
en-US.explanation: This key does not accept requests from the web page that sent this one.
steps: Add the page's origin under My Key.
Server-side clients send no origin and are not affected.

errors.message: Requests from this IP address are not allowed for this API key.

zh-CN.title: IP 地址不被允许
zh-CN.explanation: 此密钥只接受来自指定 IP 地址的请求，而本次请求来自其他地址。
steps: 请从允许的网络调用，或让服务管理员添加你的地址。

en-US.title: IP address not allowed
en-US.explanation: This key accepts requests only from specific IP addresses, and this request came from another one.
steps: Call from an allowed network, or ask the service owner to add your address.

errors.message: The console session check failed. Reload the console and try again.

zh-CN.title: 控制台会话校验失败
zh-CN.explanation: 控制台请求缺少安全令牌，或令牌已经过期。
steps: 刷新控制台页面后重试。
如果反复出现，请重新配对控制台。

en-US.title: Console session check failed
en-US.explanation: The console request was missing its security token, or the token is out of date.
steps: Reload the console page and try again.
If it keeps happening, pair the console again.

errors.message: The requested model does not exist or is not published. List the available models at /v1/models.

zh-CN.title: 找不到模型
zh-CN.explanation: 没有已发布的模型使用请求中的名称。
steps: 通过 /v1/models 查看可用模型，并准确复制模型 id。
模型也可能暂时离线，请查看状态页。

en-US.title: Model not found
en-US.explanation: No published model has the requested name.
steps: List the available models at /v1/models and copy the id exactly.
The model may also be offline for now; see the status page.

errors.message: The requested resource was not found.

zh-CN.title: 页面不存在
zh-CN.explanation: 此地址下没有任何内容。
steps: 检查地址是否输错。
从首页或文档页重新进入。

en-US.title: Page not found
en-US.explanation: There is nothing at this address.
steps: Check the address for typos.
Start again from the home page or the docs.

errors.message: This HTTP method is not allowed for this endpoint.

zh-CN.title: 不支持的请求方法
zh-CN.explanation: 此地址不接受该 HTTP 方法。
steps: 请查阅 API 文档，确认此接口要求的方法。

en-US.title: Method not allowed
en-US.explanation: This address does not accept this HTTP method.
steps: Check the API docs for the method this endpoint expects.

errors.message: The request is invalid.

zh-CN.title: 请求无效
zh-CN.explanation: 请求缺少必填字段，或包含服务无法接受的值。
steps: 对照 API 文档检查请求内容。
向管理员求助时请附上请求 ID。

en-US.title: Invalid request
en-US.explanation: The request is missing a required field or has a value the service cannot accept.
steps: Compare the request with the API docs.
Quote the request ID if you ask the owner for help.

errors.message: The request body is not valid JSON.

zh-CN.title: JSON 格式错误
zh-CN.explanation: 请求体无法解析为 JSON。
steps: 请发送合法的 JSON 对象，并把 content-type 设为 application/json。

en-US.title: Invalid JSON
en-US.explanation: The request body could not be parsed as JSON.
steps: Send a valid JSON object with content-type application/json.

errors.message: The requested maximum output tokens exceed the limit for this API key.

zh-CN.title: 超出输出长度上限
zh-CN.explanation: 请求的最大输出长度超过了此密钥的上限。
steps: 把 max_tokens（或 max_completion_tokens）降到“我的密钥”中显示的上限以内，或者不填，自动使用上限。

en-US.title: Output limit exceeded
en-US.explanation: The requested maximum output length is above the limit for this key.
steps: Lower max_tokens (or max_completion_tokens) to the limit shown on My Key, or leave it out to use the limit.

errors.message: This request needs more tokens than the per-minute token limit of this API key allows. Reduce the input or the maximum output tokens.

zh-CN.title: 单个请求超过每分钟令牌上限
zh-CN.explanation: 这一个请求需要的令牌数就超过了密钥每分钟的上限，按原样发送永远无法成功。
steps: 缩短输入，或降低最大输出长度。
如需更高的每分钟令牌上限，请联系服务管理员。

en-US.title: Request larger than the token rate limit
en-US.explanation: This single request needs more tokens than the key may use per minute, so it can never succeed as sent.
steps: Shorten the input or lower the maximum output.
Ask the service owner for a higher tokens-per-minute limit.

errors.message: Unknown engine in the request path.

zh-CN.title: 未知引擎
zh-CN.explanation: 请求路径中指定的引擎不存在。
steps: 改用 auto 路由，或在文档中核对引擎名称。

en-US.title: Unknown engine
en-US.explanation: The engine named in the request path does not exist.
steps: Use the auto route, or check the engine name in the docs.

errors.message: The request body is too large.

zh-CN.title: 请求体过大
zh-CN.explanation: 请求体超过了服务允许的大小。
steps: 减少单次请求的数据量，例如减少或压缩图片。

en-US.title: Request too large
en-US.explanation: The request body is larger than the service accepts.
steps: Send less data in one request, for example fewer or smaller images.

errors.message: Unsupported content type. Send the request body as JSON with content-type application/json.

zh-CN.title: 不支持的内容类型
zh-CN.explanation: 此接口不接受该请求体的内容类型。
steps: 请以 JSON 发送，并把 content-type 设为 application/json。

en-US.title: Unsupported content type
en-US.explanation: The request body has a content type this endpoint does not accept.
steps: Send JSON with content-type application/json.

errors.message: Too many requests from this address. Retry after the time in the retry-after header.

zh-CN.title: 该地址请求过于频繁
zh-CN.explanation: 此网络地址在短时间内发送了过多请求。
steps: 等待 retry-after 响应头给出的时间后再重试。

en-US.title: Too many requests from this address
en-US.explanation: This network address sent too many requests in a short time.
steps: Wait for the time given in the retry-after header, then try again.

errors.message: Too many failed authentication attempts from this address. Retry after the time in the retry-after header.

zh-CN.title: 已被暂时封禁
zh-CN.explanation: 此地址认证失败的次数过多，已被暂时封禁。
steps: 等待 retry-after 响应头给出的时间后再重试。
重试前请确认客户端发送的是正确的密钥。

en-US.title: Temporarily blocked
en-US.explanation: Too many failed authentication attempts came from this address, so it is blocked for a while.
steps: Wait for the time given in the retry-after header, then try again.
Check that your client sends the right key before retrying.

errors.message: Request rate limit reached for this API key. Back off and retry after the time in the retry-after header.

zh-CN.title: 已达到请求频率上限
zh-CN.explanation: 此密钥每分钟的请求数超过了上限。
steps: 等待 retry-after 响应头给出的时间后再重试。
在“我的密钥”中查看限额。

en-US.title: Request rate limit reached
en-US.explanation: This key sent more requests per minute than its limit allows.
steps: Wait for the time given in the retry-after header, then try again.
Check the limits on My Key.

errors.message: Token rate limit reached for this API key. Back off and retry after the time in the retry-after header.

zh-CN.title: 已达到令牌速率上限
zh-CN.explanation: 此密钥每分钟使用的令牌数超过了上限。
steps: 等待 retry-after 响应头给出的时间后再重试。
缩短请求，或降低最大输出长度。

en-US.title: Token rate limit reached
en-US.explanation: This key used more tokens per minute than its limit allows.
steps: Wait for the time given in the retry-after header, then try again.
Send shorter requests or lower the maximum output.

errors.message: Too many concurrent requests for this API key. Wait for a running request to finish.

zh-CN.title: 并发请求过多
zh-CN.explanation: 此密钥正在进行的请求数已达上限。
steps: 等待正在进行的请求完成后再发送新的请求。

en-US.title: Too many requests at once
en-US.explanation: This key already has as many requests running as it is allowed.
steps: Wait for a running request to finish before sending another.

errors.message: The quota for this API key is used up. It resets at the start of the next period.

zh-CN.title: 额度已用完
zh-CN.explanation: 此密钥的每日、每月或计费额度已经用完。
steps: 等待额度重置，retry-after 响应头给出了剩余时间。
如需更多额度，请联系服务管理员。

en-US.title: Quota used up
en-US.explanation: This key has used up its daily, monthly or billing quota.
steps: Wait for the quota to reset; the retry-after header gives the time.
Ask the service owner for a larger quota.

errors.message: The service is at capacity. Retry shortly.

zh-CN.title: 服务繁忙
zh-CN.explanation: 公共容量当前已全部占用。
steps: 请几秒后重试。

en-US.title: Service at capacity
en-US.explanation: All public capacity is in use right now.
steps: Retry in a few seconds.

errors.message: The requested model is not available right now. Check the service status page.

zh-CN.title: 模型暂不可用
zh-CN.explanation: 请求的模型存在，但当前没有运行。
steps: 查看状态页，稍后再试。

en-US.title: Model not available
en-US.explanation: The requested model exists but is not running right now.
steps: Check the status page, then retry later.

errors.message: The service is temporarily unavailable. Check the service status page.

zh-CN.title: 服务暂时不可用
zh-CN.explanation: 服务暂时无法处理请求。
steps: 查看状态页，稍后再试。

en-US.title: Service unavailable
en-US.explanation: The service is temporarily unable to handle requests.
steps: Check the status page, then retry later.

errors.message: Authentication is temporarily unavailable. Retry shortly.

zh-CN.title: 认证暂不可用
zh-CN.explanation: 当前无法校验密钥，出于安全考虑暂时拒绝请求。
steps: 查看状态页，稍后再试。

en-US.title: Authentication unavailable
en-US.explanation: Keys cannot be checked right now, so requests are refused for safety.
steps: Check the status page, then retry later.

errors.message: Billing is temporarily unavailable. Retry shortly.

zh-CN.title: 计费暂不可用
zh-CN.explanation: 当前无法记录用量，计费请求已暂停。
steps: 查看状态页，稍后再试。

en-US.title: Billing unavailable
en-US.explanation: Usage cannot be recorded right now, so billed requests are paused.
steps: Check the status page, then retry later.

errors.message: The model service returned an error. Quote the request_id when reporting it.

zh-CN.title: 模型服务出错
zh-CN.explanation: 模型服务在处理请求时返回了错误。
steps: 重试请求。
如果持续失败，请把请求 ID 提供给服务管理员。

en-US.title: Model service error
en-US.explanation: The model service returned an error while handling the request.
steps: Retry the request.
If it keeps failing, give the request ID to the service owner.

errors.message: The model service did not respond in time. Quote the request_id when reporting it.

zh-CN.title: 模型服务超时
zh-CN.explanation: 模型服务未能及时响应。
steps: 长时间生成请使用 stream: true。
如果持续失败，请把请求 ID 提供给服务管理员。

en-US.title: Model service timed out
en-US.explanation: The model service did not answer in time.
steps: Use stream: true for long generations.
If it keeps failing, give the request ID to the service owner.

errors.message: Internal error. Quote the request_id when reporting it.

zh-CN.title: 内部错误
zh-CN.explanation: 服务内部出现了问题。
steps: 重试请求。
如果持续失败，请把请求 ID 提供给服务管理员。

en-US.title: Internal error
en-US.explanation: Something went wrong inside the service.
steps: Retry the request.
If it keeps failing, give the request ID to the service owner.
